title: QR codes at land checkpoints
summary: QR onboarding, manual profile creation, an individual QR, and car, motorcycle, lorry and bus group journeys, including group editing, deletion and the foreign visitor SGAC reminder.

flows.name: QR tutorial
flows.outcome: Welcome and all seven tutorial steps captured through Finish.

flows.name: Individual resident profile and QR
flows.outcome: Completed: WALKTHROUGH QR RESIDENT saved as the own profile and an individual QR generated.

flows.name: Email validation
flows.outcome: Required email feedback captured before completing the profile.

flows.name: Car group
flows.outcome: A two-person car group saved, including the foreign visitor. Generation displayed an SGAC reminder and its handoff was followed.

flows.name: Motorcycle group
flows.outcome: Two-person group and QR generated. The form displays a two-person maximum.

flows.name: Lorry group
flows.outcome: Two-person group and QR generated. The form displays a four-person maximum.

flows.name: Bus group
flows.outcome: Two-person group and QR generated. The form displays a four-person maximum.

flows.name: Manage group
flows.outcome: Bus group renamed to WALKTHROUGH BUS EDITED, regenerated and deleted after confirmation.

flows.name: Checkpoint use
flows.outcome: QR presentation screens reached; actual immigration clearance requires checkpoint hardware and was not performed.

notes: The car form displays a ten-person maximum. Capacity limits are observed labels, not tested maximum-size groups. All generated groups used two members.
The group picker exposed profiles created through SGAC as well as QR. Existing unrelated profiles were preserved. These synthetic QR codes are walkthrough evidence and must not be used for travel.
